items.definition:
The total carrying amount of a note whose heading is simply financial assets, or non-current financial assets, read once from that note's own total or carrying-amount line, where the note is wholly non-current and prints no current/non-current split. It is disclosed under that bare heading in either language, including 金融資產 / 金融资产 and 非流動金融資產 / 非流动金融资产, sometimes preceded only by a numbering prefix. It is not a note whose heading goes on to name a measurement category or legacy classification, such as fair value through profit or loss, fair value through other comprehensive income, available-for-sale, held-to-maturity, debt investments or other financial assets, because each of those headings is read on its own and any one note is read only once. It is also not a total financial assets subtotal in a financial-instruments-by-category or financial-risk table, which sweeps in trade and other receivables, cash and derivatives that this line must exclude.

Take the total only from a note headed plainly financial assets, never from a category-named financial-asset note or from a financial-instruments-by-category subtotal that also contains receivables and cash. The note total of the bare 'Financial asset / Financial assets' heading of spec 4.1 and 6.1 (金融資產 / 金融资产 / 非流動金融資產), where that note is wholly non-current and prints a total rather than a current/non-current split. Its note title is ANCHORED (with an optional leading note number) precisely so it cannot also claim the longer FVTPL, FVTOCI, available-for-sale, held-to-maturity or other-financial-asset headings that children 2-7 own - two children reading one note is the defect this anchoring prevents. Reads the note TOTAL deliberately (spec 3.3). sub__ltp_nc_portion_of_fincl_asset_notes reads the same note, requires a non-current qualifier the shared vocabulary never matches, and resolves on an earlier rung.

items.definition:
The carrying amount of derivative instruments that is itself contained in the figure taken for this line: a component row printed inside the same non-current financial-asset note, captioned as derivatives, derivative financial instruments, embedded derivatives, 衍生金融工具 or 嵌入式衍生工具. It is read only from within that note, because being one of the note's own rows is what proves it sits inside the amount being reduced, and it is deducted from that amount, never added to it. It is not the note's own total and not its non-current portion, which are the amounts this component is subtracted from. It is also not a derivative balance presented in a standalone derivative financial instruments note or as its own line on the face of the statement of financial position, which is outside this line already and must not be deducted a second time, and not the fair-value gain or loss on derivatives reported in profit or loss.

Deduct only a derivative component row that appears inside the same financial-asset note, never that note's total and never a derivative balance disclosed anywhere outside it. Find_2_LTP's included_derivatives: derivative rows printed INSIDE an in-scope non-current financial-asset note, which is the inclusion proof spec 3.3 demands ('Extract specified deduction components only from within that same note'; 'A deduction must be demonstrably included in the extracted note total'). Deducted, never added (spec 4.2). It reads the same notes as every other child in this family and is distinguished by REQUIRING the component qualifier in the caption - derivative / 衍生 / 嵌入式衍生工具 - which children 1-9 veto through the shared list. Its row_caption_none_override is the shared veto list minus the component vetoes (those would remove the very rows this child exists to find) plus the note's own total row (^total$, 合計, 合计, 小計, 小计, 總額, 总额), because a component is read from inside the note and never from the note's total.

The carrying amount of investments in associates, joint ventures, jointly controlled entities or other related parties that is itself contained in the figure taken for this line: a component row printed inside the same non-current financial-asset note, captioned as investments or interests in associates or joint ventures, 於聯營公司的投資, 於合營企業的投資, 於關聯方的投資 or 長期股權投資. It is not the note's own total and not its non-current portion, which are the amounts this component is subtracted from. Nor is it the interests in associates and joint ventures reported as their own non-current lines and analysed in their own notes, which are outside this line already and must not be deducted a second time, and not the share of profit or loss of, or dividends from, those investees.

The three atomic values share one child because Find_2_LTP adds them together and they are one kind of row; all three qualifiers are in the override list - investment in associates / joint ventures / related parties, 於聯營公司的投資, 於合營企業的投資, 於關聯方的投資, 長期股權投資. This deduction belongs to LTP only: spec 4.2 - 'The CP field deducts only derivatives and other receivables', while 'the LTP field deducts derivatives, other receivables, and investments in related parties, associates, or joint ventures'. items.definition:
The amount at which the non-trade receivables class is carried after its loss allowance has already been deducted, stated by the note as a net figure — a row captioned net carrying amount, net book value, net amount, 账面价值 or 净额, or the class name qualified as net of loss allowance or net of impairment. It is disclosed inside the note dealing with other receivables, non-trade or sundry receivables, or the combined deposits, prepayments and other receivables disclosure. It is not the gross closing balance of the same class before any allowance, not the loss allowance or bad-debt provision row, and not the related-party amount reported inside that same note; those are three separate figures standing beside it. It is also not the prepayments or deposits that may share the note's title but are not other receivables.

Take only the row this note itself presents as already net of the loss allowance, never the gross closing balance, the allowance row, or a related-party sub-line inside the same note. other_receivables_net — the primary gross-pool component. Four children read this one note, so each is separated by the caption QUALIFIER. This child takes only the explicit net-carrying-amount statement of the class (账面价值 / 账面净值 / 净额 / 期末余额减坏账准备 / net carrying amount / other receivables, net), which is spec 3.2 preference 1. Its override deliberately excludes the gross markers (账面余额 / 期末余额 / closing balance / gross carrying amount) that belong to sub__cp_other_receivables_gross, the allowance captions that belong to sub__cp_other_receivables_loss_allowance, and the shared veto keeps every related-party caption out — those belong to sub__cp_other_receivables_rp. It also inherits the veto on 预付款项 / prepayments, which share the HK-style note title 预付款项、按金及其他应收款项 but are not other receivables.

cascade.note: The explicit net column of a two-level grid. FIRST because a note that prints one has stated the net itself, and the row it sits on reports the GROSS — so the fall-through rung below would read that gross as a net. A NOTE PRINTS ITS NET CARRYING AMOUNT TWO WAYS, and one part cannot read both. Either it is a ROW of its own (账面价值 / net carrying amount), whose figure is the row's reported amount, or it is a COLUMN of a 账面余额 | 坏账准备 | 账面价值 grid, where the row is captioned by the item and the reported amount of that row is the GROSS. `note_source.measure` selects a column and holds one value, so the two readings are two rungs and the cascade's first-that-resolves picks per (basis, period). MEASURED ON 河钢股份 000709: the consolidated note prints the grid and the parent-company note prints a plain comparative, so one filing needs both — and reading the grid's row as a net amount is how Other Receivables(CP) came to publish 2,407,734,161.14 against a printed 683,092,791.26.

The row's own reported amount, for a note that prints ONE figure per period rather than a gross/allowance/net grid. Reached only when no net column was found, which is what makes the reported amount the net: a one-level table states the carrying amount, and there is no allowance column beside it to deduct.

items.definition: The other-receivables note's GROSS carrying amount — 账面余额, the balance before the loss allowance is deducted. Two ways a note prints it and this part reads both: as a row captioned 账面余额 / 期末余额 / closing balance, and as the PRIMARY COLUMN of a 账面余额 | 坏账准备 grid whose row is captioned by the item itself. The second needs `from_measure_grid: true`, because the primary column has no measure suffix to ask for and a plain comparative's single figure sits in the same place while being a different quantity — the amount the filing reports, not a gross awaiting its deduction. It is not the net: CP_P2 subtracts the allowance from this.

items.label: Other receivables note — loss allowance / bad-debt provision
items.definition:
The loss allowance, bad-debt provision, credit-loss or impairment provision standing against the non-trade receivables class at the reporting date — 坏账准备, 信用损失准备, 损失准备 or their English equivalents — which is a deduction from those receivables and not a receivable itself. It appears in the note dealing with other receivables, non-trade receivables, or the combined deposits, prepayments and other receivables disclosure, typically as a less-prefixed line sitting between the gross balance and the net one. It is not the gross balance it is deducted from, and it is not the net amount left after deducting it. It is also not a movement in the allowance — the amount provided, written off, recovered or reversed during the period — nor an allowance roll-forward's opening or accumulated column; only the provision standing at the reporting date counts.

Take the allowance standing against these receivables at the reporting date, never the gross or net balance it sits between, and never the period's charge, write-off, recovery or reversal. The loss allowance disclosed in the other-receivables note — 坏账准备 / 信用损失准备 / 信用减值准备 / 损失准备 / 减值准备 / 壞賬準備 / loss allowance / allowance for expected credit losses / provision for impairment. This is a NEGATIVE row and it is deliberately CLAIMED, not vetoed: it is the only child that overrides the family's allowance veto, and it enters the parent cascade as an adjustment term with sign -1 so that gross less allowance equals the net carrying amount the spec requires (3.2 preference 2). Vetoing it instead would overstate the line. It still vetoes the allowance ROLL-FORWARD rows — 本期计提 / 核销 / 转回 / 收回 / additions / written off — and the accumulated forms and the roll-forward's own 期初余额 / 期末余额, so only the balance-sheet-date allowance is taken and the movement is never double counted. It also vetoes the net and gross markers owned by its two siblings and every related-party caption.

items.definition:
The portion of long-term receivables falling due within one year of the reporting date, at its carrying amount after any allowance against it — a receivable reclassified out of non-current assets into the current pool solely because of its maturity. It is disclosed in the note dealing with long-term receivables, or with non-current assets maturing within one year, which is where a filing sets the maturing slice out from the rest of the class. It is not the whole long-term receivables balance, and not the part still falling due after more than one year; it is also not the combined total of all non-current assets maturing within one year, which can additionally contain maturing loans and advances and other maturing classes that are extracted separately. Related-party amounts disclosed in the same note are a separate figure and not part of this one.

Take only the slice of long-term receivables maturing within one year, never the full long-term balance and never the combined maturing-non-current-assets total that surrounds it. current_long_term_receivables_net. Reads the 一年内到期的非流动资产 / 长期应收款 note. Its note can be an OMNIBUS note that also lists sibling classes (一年内到期的贷款及垫款 and other maturing non-current assets), so it carries a narrowed row_caption_any_override limited to the 一年内到期的长期应收款 caption — that is what stops it re-claiming a row another child already owns, and it enforces spec 4.2's rule that when 一年内到期的非流动资产 is a combined total only the component explicitly attributable to 一年内到期的长期应收款 may be used. The family veto anchors out the combined 一年内到期的非流动资产 caption, the bare 长期应收款 caption and every 非流动 / over-one-year row, so no non-current amount reaches the current pool. Related-party rows in this same note belong to sub__cp_current_ltr_rp and are vetoed here.

items.definition:
The portion of loans and advances extended to borrowers that falls due within one year of the reporting date, at its carrying amount after the allowance against it. It is disclosed in the note dealing with loans and advances, or with the current portion of loans and advances, where the maturing slice is set out separately from the rest of the class. It is not the whole loans and advances balance that the note discloses, and not the part maturing after more than one year; substituting the class total for its current portion would pull non-current lending into a current line. Related-party borrowers identified inside the same note are a separate figure.

Take the within-one-year portion of loans and advances, never the note's whole loans-and-advances balance and never its non-current part. current_loans_and_advances_net. Reads the 发放贷款及垫款 / 贷款及垫款 note, a single-class note, so it uses the family's shared row vocabulary verbatim — no override is needed and none is given. The shared any-list only contains the CURRENT-portion caption (一年内到期的贷款及垫款 / loans and advances due within one year / current portion of loans and advances) plus the net-carrying-amount captions; the shared veto anchors out the bare 发放贷款及垫款 / 贷款及垫款 caption and every 非流动 / 一年以上 row, so the whole class total can never substitute for its current portion and non-current loans and advances never enter the CP pool (spec 5.1, 5.3). Related-party rows here belong to sub__cp_current_loans_advances_rp.

items.definition:
Money placed out with banks or other financial institutions under interbank placement arrangements, at its carrying amount after any allowance, to the extent that balance is reported within current assets — an asset representing funds lent to another institution. It is disclosed in the note dealing with placements with banks and other financial institutions, or with funds or deposits placed with such institutions. It is not cash at bank or a deposit held as part of cash and cash equivalents, and it is not the mirror-image liability arising where the entity has taken funds in from other institutions. Related-party placements shown inside the same note are a separate figure.

Take the placement asset disclosed by this note, never cash and bank balances, never funds the entity has taken in from other institutions, and never a related-party sub-line. funds_placed_net. Reads the 拆出资金 / 拆放同业 / placements-with-banks note, a single-class note, so it too uses the family's shared row vocabulary verbatim — it takes the 拆出资金 class row or its explicit net carrying amount. The shared veto keeps out the note's own 合计 total, its allowance row, its opening and closing balances and all movement rows. items.definition:
Non-trade running-account balances receivable from other units — internal, inter-unit or inter-company current accounts, 往来款 and its variants — at their carrying amount after any allowance. They are disclosed in the note dealing with current accounts or internal and unit current accounts, or in the other current assets note when that is the only place the current account is shown. It is not the total of that other current assets note, which can also carry other receivables and maturing non-current items extracted separately, so taking the omnibus total in place of the current-account row would double count them. It is also not a current-account balance the entity owes rather than is owed, and not the related-party current account disclosed inside the same note.

Take only the current-account receivable row itself, never the other-current-assets note's omnibus total and never a current-account balance the entity owes. current_account_receivables_net. Reads the 往来款 note, or the 其他流动资产 note when 往来款 is only disclosed there. Because 其他流动资产 is an OMNIBUS note that can also contain 其他应收款 and 一年内到期 rows already owned by sibling children, this child carries a narrowed row_caption_any_override limited to the current-account captions (往来款 / 内部往来 / 单位往来 / current account) and their explicit net form. That is what prevents it double-claiming a sibling's row, and it also means the 其他流动资产 TOTAL is never taken — spec 5.2: do not add an 其他流动资产 total when the qualifying components within it have already been extracted. Related-party current accounts belong to sub__cp_current_account_rp and are vetoed here.

items.definition:
The part of the non-trade receivables class that is owed by related parties — parents, subsidiaries, associates, joint ventures, fellow subsidiaries, controlling shareholders and other counterparties the filing itself identifies as related — read from the same note that discloses the class. It exists so that a related-party amount already sitting inside the other-receivables balance can be carved back out of a third-party line. It is not the class total that contains it, and it is not the entity's own balances payable to related parties, advances received or contract liabilities on the other side of the balance sheet. It is also not a related-party transaction volume, turnover or guarantee amount with no receivable outstanding at the reporting date, and not a share of the class's pooled allowance.

Take only the receivable balance this note attributes to related parties inside the other-receivables class, never the class total, never a due-to-related-party amount, and never a transaction or guarantee volume. other_receivables_related_party_net — the deduction leg for the other-receivables component. It shares its note with three siblings and is separated from them by the RELATED-PARTY qualifier alone: 关联方 / 关联单位 / 关联企业 / 关联公司 / 母公司 / 子公司 / 联营企业 / 合营企业 / 受同一控制方控制的企业 / 应收关联方款项 / 关联方组合 / due from related parties — exactly the spec 3.3 identification list, so related-party status is never inferred from a counterparty name. Overriding the family's related-party veto is the whole point of this child. Its own veto adds the spec 4.4 exclusions: 应付关联方款项 and other due-TO balances, 预收款项, 合同负债, related-party investments, 担保金额, and transaction volumes with no outstanding balance. It also vetoes the pooled allowance, because spec 4.3 forbids allocating a pooled allowance to related parties. Enters the cascade with sign -1 and only ever deducts an amount read from the same note that supplied the gross component, which is what makes it proven-included (spec 5.3).

items.definition:
The part of the long-term receivables maturing within one year that is owed by related parties, as that note identifies them. It is read from the note dealing with long-term receivables or with non-current assets maturing within one year — the same note that discloses the maturing slice itself — so the related-party amount can be carved out of a line that would otherwise be third-party only. It is not related-party long-term receivables still falling due after more than one year, which never entered the current pool and so must not be deducted from it. It is also not the whole maturing slice, and not an amount payable to a related party.

Deduct only the related-party amount inside the within-one-year slice of long-term receivables, never a related-party long-term balance maturing later and never the whole slice. current_long_term_receivables_related_party_net. items.definition:
The part of the loans and advances maturing within one year that is owed by related-party borrowers, as the note identifies them. It is read from the note dealing with loans and advances or with their current portion — the same note that supplies the current-portion figure — which is what shows the amount is already inside the balance being reduced. It is not related-party lending falling due after more than one year, which lies outside the current pool and must not be deducted from it, and it is not the whole current portion. Entrusted or on-lent arrangements to a related party do belong here when that balance sits within the current portion.

Deduct only the related-party share of loans and advances maturing within one year, never a related-party loan due after one year and never the whole current portion. current_loans_and_advances_related_party_net. Its veto blocks the bare and the non-current loans-and-advances captions, so non-current loans and advances are never deducted (spec 5.3). Note that 委托贷款 / entrusted loans are deliberately NOT vetoed here: spec 5.3 states the LTP entrusted-loan exclusion does not carry over to this field, so a related-party entrusted loan sitting inside the CP gross pool is deducted like any other related-party amount. items.definition:
The part of the interbank placement balance that is placed with a related institution — a parent, a fellow subsidiary, an associate or another counterparty the filing identifies as related. It is read from the same placements-with-banks or funds-placed note that supplies the placement figure, since only an amount shown inside that balance can be carved out of it. It is not the whole placement balance, and it is not funds taken in from a related institution, which is a liability rather than a receivable. It is also not a related-party placement mentioned only as a transaction elsewhere without being shown inside this class at the reporting date.

Deduct only the related-party placement shown inside this note, never the note's whole placement balance and never funds the entity has taken in from a related institution. funds_placed_related_party_net. Related-party placements inside the 拆出资金 / 拆放同业 note, separated from sub__cp_funds_placed_net — which reads that same note — by the related-party qualifier. It is deducted only because the same note supplies the gross component, which is what makes the amount proven-included in CP_Gross (spec 5.3). Sign -1.

items.definition:
The part of the current-account receivable balance that is due from related parties — intra-group and other related-unit running accounts, 关联方往来款 and its variants — as the filing identifies them. It is read from the same current-account or other current assets note that supplies the current-account figure, since only an amount shown inside that balance can be carved out of it. It is not the whole current-account balance, and it is not a current account the entity owes to a related party, which sits on the liability side. It is also not the related-party transaction turnover for the period; only the balance outstanding at the reporting date counts.

Deduct only the related-party balance shown inside this current-account receivable, never the whole current-account figure and never an amount the entity owes a related party. current_account_receivables_related_party_net. Related-party current-account balances (关联方往来款 / 关联方资金往来 / 关联单位往来) inside the 往来款 or 其他流动资产 note, separated from sub__cp_current_account_net by the related-party qualifier. This is the commonest place a PRC filing parks intra-group balances, so it is usually the deduction that decides this line. Sign -1.

items.label: Intermediate residual — how far below zero the securities arithmetic went

cascade.note: 0 − the securities expression, which is that expression with every sign inverted. PASSED OVER WHEN NEGATIVE, so it carries a figure only where the expression came out at or below zero — precisely the filings where the securities line falls to its zero rung — and that figure is how far below zero it went. The constant 0 is deliberately NOT a term: as a `required` one it would alone satisfy `_apply_terms`' base-present test, so a filing disclosing none of the in-scope notes would publish a bare 0 instead of leaving this unresolved. Nothing references it; it is stored so the overshoot is reviewable rather than invisible, and `in_output: false` keeps it off the statement and the export.

items.label: Find 1 — related-party receivables in the balance sheet
items.definition: FIND 1 — the spec's first reading: the related-party receivable balance as the BALANCE SHEET ITSELF prints it, never assembled from a note. This is the first of three readings of one quantity — Find 2 takes it from the four receivable notes and Find 3 from the related-party note — and it exists so that the face's own figure is one of the candidates the parent chooses between. It is an amount owed TO the reporting entity by a related party: a fellow subsidiary, the immediate or ultimate holding company, a shareholder, a director, an associate, a joint venture or any other related party, INCLUDING a trade receivable from one. It EXCLUDES entrusted loans (委托贷款) routed through a bank, which the specification excludes in its own words and which have their own columns, and it excludes anything owed BY the entity.

cascade.note:
The NON-CURRENT related-party receivable rows the balance sheet prints, added up. Every term is `any_of`, so a filing disclosing one of them resolves the rung and one disclosing none leaves Find 1 empty rather than publishing zero.

WHY ONLY THE NON-CURRENT ONES. This Find feeds `bs_nca__due_from_related_parties_ltp`, which the template rolls up into total non-current assets, while every CURRENT related-party receivable column (`bs_ca__due_from_related_parties_cp`, the JV and partnership line, the related-party trade receivable and the trade-and-other aggregate) is a child of total CURRENT assets and publishes in its own right. Adding those here puts one balance in both sections. Measured on China SCE, whose face prints a single "Due from related parties" 4,065,231 under CURRENT ASSETS: with them, the non-current children summed to 52,567,208 against a printed 49,227,234 — an overshoot of 3,339,974; without them the residual is -725,257, which is the ordinary under-extraction.

THE SIX ENTRUSTED-LOAN COLUMNS ARE ABSENT on purpose: 但不包括委托贷款, the spec's own exclusion, expressed by not naming them so there is no pattern to get wrong. The parent is not a term either — it selects between the three Finds, so naming it here would be a cycle.

BOTH MATURITIES IS THE DECLARED INTENT, and this Find is the one place that does not follow it. Instructed: "Template intent is both long and short term on related party." Find 3 already reads both — its row captions take 其他应收款 and 一年内到期的长期应收款 alongside 长期应收款 — and on 000709 it is the rung that wins, so the column publishes 379,049,251.75 / 347,653,398.14: the whole related-party receivable note net of its allowance, current balances included. The intent is therefore already met wherever the note is read.

WHAT KEEPS THE FACE RUNG NON-CURRENT ANYWAY is a measurement, not a disagreement with the instruction. Widening this rung to the four current columns (bs_ca__due_from_related_parties_cp, the JV and partnership line, the related-party trade receivable and the trade-and-other aggregate) was tried and measured on the corpus: on China SCE 1966 it published the face's 4,065,231 / 3,914,425 into the LTP column while bs_ca__due_from_related_parties_cp still published the same balance, and the bs_nca__total_non_current_assets reconciliation went from tying EXACTLY (49,227,234 reported against 49,227,234 accounted, and 60,780,612 against 60,780,612) to `mixed_scale` — the one section relation that filing proves, lost. The face prints CP and LTP as two rows and the template rolls them into two different section totals, so a face reading cannot take both without counting one balance twice; a NOTE reading can, because the note is a decomposition and not a section. That is the split the three Finds now record.

items.definition: FIND 2 — the spec's second reading: the related-party balances disclosed INSIDE the four receivable notes (其他应收款, 一年内到期的非流动资产, 长期应收款, 发放贷款及垫款, and their trade-receivable and English equivalents), as opposed to the related-party note Find 3 reads. A filing discloses the same quantity in both places and the two rarely agree, which is why the parent takes the largest. Read the balances owed TO the reporting entity: do not read a 合计 row, an 应付 row, a transaction volume (交易金额, 本期发生额), an opening balance or a movement, an entrusted loan (委托贷款), or a loss allowance — each has its own line or is excluded by the specification.

items.label: Find 3 — related-party balances in the related-party note

cascade.note: FIND 3 IS THE NET, and the note it reads publishes only the two halves. The spec asks for the 淨金額 (net amount); a 关联方应收应付款项 table prints 账面余额 and 坏账准备 and no net column, so the net is gross LESS allowance and has to be computed here. Measured on 000709 when Find 3 read the primary measure alone: 952,910,390.11 against a true net of 554,344,602.47, overstated by 398,565,787.64 — and 565,528,459.41 of that was one counterparty, 河北承钢工贸, whose allowance EQUALS its gross, so its net is zero and it had been counted at face value. The allowance is an `adjustment`, so a note printing no allowance column simply deducts nothing rather than killing the rung, and `refuse_negative` catches an allowance larger than the gross — which would mean the two columns had been read the wrong way round.

items.definition: FIND 3 — the spec's third reading: the net amounts attributable to related parties, excluding entrusted loans, disclosed in the 关联方及关联交易 note. Computed, not read: that note prints a carrying amount and a loss allowance and no net column, so this is the 账面余额 total LESS the 坏账准备 total. Its two halves are sub__rp_find_3_gross and sub__rp_find_3_allowance.

items.label: Non-operating income (face row)
items.definition: The income-statement row a mainland filing prints as 营业外收入 — non-operating income: gains outside ordinary operating activity that CAS presents on this line (government grants unrelated to ordinary activity presented here, penalty and compensation income, donations received, gains on debt restructuring). Read OFF THE FACE of the income statement, above 利润总额. It is one of the two halves of the template's single net column Other Non-Operating Inc(Exp), which is its parent and which sums the two. It is NOT 其他收益, NOT 投资收益 and NOT 资产处置收益 — each of those has its own template line — and it is not the net of income and expense.

items.label: Non-operating expenses (face row)
items.definition: The income-statement row a mainland filing prints as 营业外支出 — non-operating expenses: losses outside ordinary operating activity that CAS presents on this line (donations made, penalties and fines paid, extraordinary losses, losses on debt restructuring). Read OFF THE FACE of the income statement, above 利润总额, where CAS prints it as an UNSIGNED POSITIVE magnitude that the statement's own arithmetic deducts. It is one of the two halves of the template's single net column Other Non-Operating Inc(Exp), which is its parent and which sums the two, so this part must carry the figure NEGATIVE — see its sign_rule, which negates the CAS caption only, and its negative_expected sign_convention, which flags any remaining positive for review rather than coercing it.

items.label: Income taxes paid (direct-method face row)
items.definition: The cash-flow row a mainland filing prints as 支付的各项税费 — the income taxes and other levies actually PAID in cash during the period, read off the face of the direct-method operating section (CAS 31 presents the direct method on the face and the indirect reconciliation as a note). CAS prints it as an UNSIGNED POSITIVE magnitude that the statement's own 经营活动现金流出小计 subtotal deducts, so this part must carry the figure NEGATIVE — see its sign_rule, which negates the CAS captions only and leaves an HKFRS filing's already-bracketed figure alone. It is one of the two halves of the template's single net column Income Taxes Paid(Direct), which is its parent and which sums the two; the other half is the refund received. It is NOT the income tax EXPENSE of the income statement, which accrues rather than pays and has its own template line.

items.label: Tax refunds received (direct-method face row)
items.definition: The cash-flow row a mainland filing prints as 收到的税费返还 — refunds of tax RECEIVED in cash, most often the VAT export rebate and overpaid income tax, read off the face of the direct-method operating section above 经营活动现金流入小计. It is a cash INFLOW and stays positive. It is the second half of the template's single net column Income Taxes Paid(Direct), which is its parent and which sums the two, so the parent reports taxes paid NET of refunds — which is what a template carrying one tax line per statement can mean. Before this part existed the caption reached no concept and was swept into the operating section's residual bucket alongside the indirect reconciliation's non-cash adjustments, where it was added to two other direct-method rows under one figure.

items.label: Find 3 — related-party note, carrying amount before allowance
items.definition: The related-party receivable balances the related-party note tabulates, at their CARRYING AMOUNT BEFORE the loss allowance — the 账面余额 column, which is the column such a note prints first. A mainland 关联方应收应付款项 table is laid out 项目 | 账面余额 | 坏账准备 | 账面余额 | 坏账准备, two measures under each of 期末余额 and 期初余额, and it prints NO net column: the net has to be computed. Read the 账面余额 figures only. Do NOT read 坏账准备, which is the allowance and is its own line (sub__rp_find_3_allowance); do NOT read a 合计 row, which totals the rows above it; do NOT read 应付 rows, transaction-volume rows (交易金额, 本期发生额), or the 关联方组合 row of an expected-credit-loss staging table, whose 账面余额 is a portfolio exposure rather than a balance owed. This line is GROSS on purpose — Find 3 subtracts the allowance from it — so answering with a net figure here double-counts the deduction. READING BOTH MATURITIES HERE IS DELIBERATE — "Template intent is both long and short term on related party" — and it is what puts current-asset money in a non-current column. Measured on 000709: this rung wins MAX_VALID with 379,049,251.75 (gross 952,910,390.11 less allowance 573,861,138.36) and bs_nca__total_non_current_assets then over-accounts by 790,644,795.95, of which this line is 379,049,251.75. The arithmetic cost is recorded here rather than fixed by narrowing the rung, because which column the balance belongs in is the template's decision and the template's decision is both.

others_master.note: The section residuals — each line is its section's unexplained remainder, filled only by the sweep in `residual_framework`. Marking a line here is what makes it a bucket: `value_scope` and `residual_policy` are derived from this list at load, so the fact is stated once instead of three times per line.

cross_check_master.note: The calculated lines whose PRINTED subtotal is read off the filing and compared against the figure the components come to. A disagreement is a finding, not a correction: the published figure stays the computed one and the review queue carries the printed one beside it, because a component is then mis-mapped, missing or double-counted and that is what an analyst has to look at. A line left out of this list is still computed and published; it simply is not compared.

prose_grammar.note: How a filing places a figure in a sentence. Authored once: measured over the 28 hand-written patterns this replaces, the subject and the connective were identical on all seven prose lines and only the destination differed.
